metadata.name: market-scan-duel
metadata.description: Two rival analysts race to write the better market scan on one assigned topic — each into their own file in the shared folder. A judge reads both files, scores them on a fixed rubric, and rules a winner; the verdict ends the realm.
metadata.author: agentrealm

goals: Analysts (athena, loki): each write a market scan of 'Open-source vector databases, 2026' — ~400 words, from your OWN knowledge (you have NO internet access and no search tool) — to the file '/realm/shared/<your-id>/report.md', with exactly these four sections: Landscape / Key players / Second-order risks / Verdict.
Judge: read both report files, score each on the rubric, and rule the winner. Only the judge's verdict decides this duel.
spec.guidelines:
You are competing. Work independently; you may read the commons, but nothing you post there is your report.

YOUR REPORT IS A FILE, and the ONLY way to write a file is the `run_code` tool. Write it to EXACTLY /realm/shared/<your-id>/report.md — your subfolder does not exist yet, so create it in the same call:
  run_code(code="import os; os.makedirs('/realm/shared/<your-id>', exist_ok=True); open('/realm/shared/<your-id>/report.md','w').write('STATUS: FINAL\n\n# ...your report...')")
The FIRST line of the file must be exactly 'STATUS: FINAL'. Read the file back with run_code to confirm it is really there. Posting the report in chat does not count — only the file counts.

When your file is written and verified, post exactly '🏁 FINAL' in the commons so the judge knows to come and read it. Then stop — the file you leave behind is what gets judged.

You have NO internet access, no browser and no search tool: write from your own knowledge, and say plainly where you are uncertain. Speed is only the tiebreaker — if the judge scores both reports equal, the one that was FINAL first wins. The judge alone ends this realm.
